## Load Saved Output

```{r}
load(path_here("data", "processed", "NPC_chrX", "list_muS_unified_260614.RData"))
```

## Setup

```{r}
fig_dir <- path_here("results", "NPC_chrX", "figures")
heatmap_dir <- file.path(fig_dir, "heatmaps")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(heatmap_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

method_levels_display <- c(
  "Raw",
  "HiCBZIP-GB(NB)",
  "HiCBZIP-N(M)",
  "HiCImpute",
  "scHiCluster",
  "Higashi",
  "Fast-Higashi"
)

method_label_map <- c(
  "Raw" = "Simulated (Raw)",
  "HiCBZIP-GB(NB)" = "HiCBZIP-GB(NB)",
  "HiCBZIP-N(M)" = "HiCBZIP-N(M)",
  "HiCImpute" = "HiCImpute",
  "scHiCluster" = "scHiCluster",
  "Higashi" = "Higashi",
  "Fast-Higashi" = "Fast-Higashi"
)

cov_label_df <- tibble(
  coverage = lambda_list,
  coverage_label = paste0(lambda_list, "\n", sparsity_labels, " zero")
)

K_display <- ncol(list_muS_combine[[1]])
first_cell_col <- 1
first_cell_label <- paste0("cell ", first_cell_col)
```

## Heatmap Table

```{r}
heatmap_cov <- "1e-02"

heatmap_df <- tibble(
  method = c("Truth", method_levels_display),
  method_label = c("Truth", unname(method_label_map[method_levels_display])),
  muS = c(
    list(replicate(K_display, bulk)),
    lapply(method_levels_display, function(method_i) {
      list_muS_combine[[paste0(method_i, ",ld=", heatmap_cov)]]
    })
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    q95 = map_dbl(muS, ~ quantile(.x, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)),
    q99 = map_dbl(muS, ~ quantile(.x, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)),
    mean_value = map_dbl(muS, ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    maxi_plot = q95 * 2
  )

heatmap_df %>%
  select(method_label, q95, q99, mean_value, maxi_plot)
```

## First-Cell Heatmap Comparison

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
plot_first_cell_heatmaps_real1 <- function(heatmap_df) {
  panel_title_size <- 12
  axis_title_size <- 8
  axis_text_size <- 8
  top_title_size <- 16
  tick_by <- 100

  plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(heatmap_df)), function(i) {
    model_i <- as.character(heatmap_df$method_label[[i]])
    maxi_i <- heatmap_df$maxi_plot[[i]]
    x <- matrix_long_to_matrix2D(heatmap_df$muS[[i]][, first_cell_col])

    mat_to_heatmap(x, maxi_i) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(size = panel_title_size, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
        axis.text = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, nrow(x), by = tick_by)) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, nrow(x), by = tick_by)) +
      ggtitle(model_i)
  })

  gridExtra::grid.arrange(
    grobs = plots,
    ncol = 4,
    top = grid::textGrob(
      label = bquote("NPC250k, Cell 1, Chr X, " * lambda == .(as.numeric(heatmap_cov))),
      gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = top_title_size, fontface = "bold")
    )
  )
}

plot_first_cell_heatmaps_real1(heatmap_df)
```

```{r}
png(
  filename = file.path(heatmap_dir, "heatmap_first_cell_all_methods_real1_NPC250k_0h_chrX.png"),
  width = 1800,
  height = 1000,
  res = 220
)
plot_first_cell_heatmaps_real1(heatmap_df)
dev.off()
```

## First-Cell Heatmap Comparison (log1p Scale)

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
plot_first_cell_heatmaps_real1_log1p <- function(heatmap_df) {
  panel_title_size <- 12
  axis_title_size <- 8
  axis_text_size <- 8
  top_title_size <- 16
  tick_by <- 100

  plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(heatmap_df)), function(i) {
    model_i <- as.character(heatmap_df$method_label[[i]])
    x <- matrix_long_to_matrix2D(heatmap_df$muS[[i]][, first_cell_col])
    x_log1p <- log1p(x)
    count_max_i <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(x_log1p, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE))
    if (!is.finite(count_max_i)) count_max_i <- max(x_log1p, na.rm = TRUE)
    count_max_i <- max(count_max_i, 1e-6)

    mat_to_heatmap(x_log1p, count_max_i) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(size = panel_title_size, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
        axis.text = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, nrow(x_log1p), by = tick_by)) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, nrow(x_log1p), by = tick_by)) +
      ggtitle(model_i)
  })

  gridExtra::grid.arrange(
    grobs = plots,
    ncol = 4,
    top = grid::textGrob(
      label = bquote("NPC250k, Cell 1, Chr X, " * lambda == .(as.numeric(heatmap_cov))),
      gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = top_title_size, fontface = "bold")
    )
  )
}

plot_first_cell_heatmaps_real1_log1p(heatmap_df)
```

```{r}
png(
  filename = file.path(heatmap_dir, "heatmap_first_cell_all_methods_real1_NPC250k_0h_chrX_log1p.png"),
  width = 1800,
  height = 1000,
  res = 220
)
plot_first_cell_heatmaps_real1_log1p(heatmap_df)
dev.off()
```

## SCC Across Coverage

```{r}
scc_display <- scc_muS %>%
  mutate(
    Method = recode(as.character(Method), !!!method_label_map),
    Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Simulated (Raw)", "HiCBZIP-GB(NB)", "HiCBZIP-N(M)", "HiCImpute", "scHiCluster", "Higashi", "Fast-Higashi")),
    coverage = factor(ld, levels = lambda_list, ordered = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(Method != "Simulated (Raw)") %>%
  left_join(cov_label_df, by = c("ld" = "coverage"))
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
p_scc_real1 <- ggplot(
  scc_display,
  aes(x = ld_num, y = SCC, fill = Method, color = Method, group = interaction(Method, ld_num))
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.size = 0.8,
    width = 0.24,
    linewidth = 0.45,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.24)
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = lambda_vals,
    labels = names(sparsity_list),
    sec.axis = dup_axis(
      breaks = lambda_vals,
      labels = sparsity_labels,
      name = "Sparsity"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression(lambda),
    y = "SCC",
    title = "Stratum-Adjusted Correlation Coefficient Across Coverage Levels"
  ) +
  manuscript_theme() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x.top = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x.top = element_text(margin = margin(b = 8))
  )

p_scc_real1 <- apply_manuscript_colors(p_scc_real1)
p_scc_real1
```

```{r}
save_manuscript_plot(
  p_scc_real1,
  "real1_scc",
  fig_dir = fig_dir,
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)
```

  )
